t: Clojure for Lisp Programmers Part 1 - Rich Hickey

q.x: You should watch Rich Hickey's talk "Clojure for Lisp Programmers" [link] [link]

desc: Part 1 of a presentation by Rich Hickey at the Boston Lisp meeting. A fairly extensive introduction to Clojure, with a presumption of prior knowledge of Lisp. Transcript available at: http://clojure.googlegroups.com/web/clojure-for-lispers-transcript.txt

recs.x: You should watch Rich Hickey's talk "Clojure for Lisp Programmers" [link] [link]

Context: this is not only a very good introduction to Clojure and the design decisions made by Rich Hickey it also is a video that isn't very widely known.

The video was uploaded to Youtube after the migration from Blip.tv but somehow got broken ( [link] ) and lived in a parallel universe in Youtube. I remember I found the video a few years ago but was unable to watch it.

really good talk from Rich Hickey:
Clojure for Lisp Programmers - [link]
